slides.title: 課文大意：貓是很好的寵物
points: 很多人養貓或 kittens（小貓）當寵物。牠們會 purr（發出呼嚕聲），讓人開心。
很多貓很友善，喜歡坐在你的 lap（大腿）上，也很 playful（愛玩的）。
貓是乾淨的動物，通常不需要 baths（洗澡），但一天要 feed（餵）一到兩次，也要給乾淨的水。
有些 stray（流浪的）貓需要家；很多貓一天睡 6–12 小時，常常睡在你的床上！
examples: Many people get cats or kittens for pets.
But you need to feed them once or twice a day.

slides.title: 對話大意：Milo 撿到小貓，Ken 不太想養
points: Milo 在公寓外面餵一隻流浪小貓，牠很瘦、需要洗澡，Betty 說：You feel sorry for it.
Milo 想帶牠回家：It's very friendly and playful.
Ken 不興奮：貓會到處掉 fur（毛），還會 scratch（抓）家具。
Ivy 說貓對健康好：摸貓可以 lower your stress level，陪貓可以 improve your mood。
examples: I'm not excited about it.
Once it's in the apartment, it would never leave.

slides.title: 重點單字（一）
points: kitten (n) 小貓：The kittens are very cute.
lap (n)（坐著時的）大腿部：Dad put his hands in his lap.
playful (adj) 愛玩的；活潑的：Her dog is very playful.
bath (n) 洗澡：The children need baths.（take a bath 洗澡）
feed (v) 餵養：feed – fed – fed；What are they feeding us for dinner?
slides.tip: feed 的過去式是 fed，不是 feeded。

slides.title: 重點單字（二）
points: building (n) 大樓；建築物：That building is very tall.
excited (adj) 興奮的：be excited about…；We're very excited about our trip.
fur (n)（動物的）毛：His dog's fur is very soft.
lower (v) 降低：Can you lower your voice?
noisy (adj) 吵鬧的：The children are very noisy!
purr (v) 發出呼嚕聲；stray (adj) 流浪的；scratch (v) 抓；stress (n) 壓力
slides.tip: excited（人覺得興奮） vs. exciting（事情令人興奮）：I'm excited. / The game is exciting.

slides.title: 片語：feel sorry for / be sorry about
points: feel sorry for + 人／動物：同情、覺得…可憐
be sorry about + 事情：對不幸的事或糟糕的情況感到遺憾
examples: And you feel sorry for it.
We all felt sorry for Emma when she was crying.
The boy feels sorry for the dead bird.
I'm so sorry about the accident.
I'm sorry about your job loss.

slides.title: 句型：Would…? 推測與委婉請求
points: would 放句首，表達假設、推測或比較委婉的看法。
也可以表達禮貌的請求：Would you please…? / I would like…
would 後面接原形動詞。
examples: Would it make a nice pet?
Would this color look good on me?
Would that be a good idea?
Would you please close the window?
I would like a cup of coffee, please.

slides.title: outside：介系詞 vs. 副詞
points: 介系詞（prep）：outside + 名詞＝在…外面
副詞（adv）：放句尾修飾動詞＝在外面
examples: Milo is feeding a stray cat outside our apartment building.
Please leave your shoes outside the door.
There is a big tree outside my window.
It is raining outside.
The kids are playing outside.

slides.title: 動名詞當主詞：V-ing … can …
points: 動名詞片語（V-ing…）可以當整句的主詞。
動名詞主詞視為單數：Stretching… is important（不是 are）。
examples: Spending time with a cat can also improve your mood.
Petting a cat can lower your stress level.
Stretching before and after a run is important.
Playing basketball with friends makes me happy.
slides.tip: Not + V-ing 也可以當主詞：Not using your phone before bed helps you sleep.

slides.title: 句型：Do you want to + 原形動詞…?
points: 詢問對方想不想做某事，to 後面接原形動詞。
回答：Yes, I do. / Sure! / No, thanks.
examples: Do you want to bring it home?
Do you want to listen to music?
Do you want to go for a ride?

slides.title: 句型：… can + 動詞 + your …；其他片語
points: 某件事可以改善／放鬆你的…：主詞 + can + V + your + 名詞
give it a try 試試看；give away 送出去；bring it home 帶回家
examples: Walking can improve your health.
Traveling can relax your mind.
Maybe Milo could bring it home, and you could give it a try.
Do you have one to give away?
slides.tip: can 後面一定是原形動詞：can improve ✓，can improves ✗
